name: @educateos/admin
description: EducateOS operations admin (SCHO-263): one package for admin.educateos.io (hosted) and the open-source admin a district deploys into its own account. A Worker with D1 (operators, workspace registry, ops keys, cached analytics aggregates, audit log; never student records), Access sign-in, a Kumo SPA, and signed calls to each district's /api/ops/*. Its development config is wrangler.local.jsonc, not wrangler.jsonc, so release discovery and the deploy config generators never pick it up.
